title: Giant Japan 2027 Propel Advanced SL 1 size-S weight recheck
notes: The manufacturer identifies the 2027 Propel Advanced SL 1 and claims 6.8 kg in size S. Its listed reference build uses Ultegra Di2, SLR 0 50 wheels and CADEX 28c tires, with two cages, a mount, tubeless valve and sealant; pedals are N/A. Giant says individual weight may vary. This is a Japan-market size-S reference and does not establish the retained mainland build.
